prompt: 为一个名叫 Pocket 的开发者工具设计一个手机主题的 SVG logo。使用透明背景、深色主体和少量浅色细节，整体简洁，在 32px 时仍能辨认。画布为 240×240，直接生成可编辑的 logo.svg。只在当前项目目录内完成工作，不发布。
conditions: Separate fresh temporary Git projects and ephemeral CLI sessions; same prompt and configured model/reasoning settings. Only the with-skill project contained continuous-corners. Other installed skills remained available. This was not a hermetic environment benchmark.
limitations: One paired example, not a trigger-rate or visual-quality benchmark.
Composition, details, dimensions, and corner parameters were chosen independently; full-image differences are not isolated corner effects.
Neither SVG is the iphone-use production logo.
No Apple/Figma exact-match or Claude model behavior claim.

preview.background: white preview only; original SVGs remain transparent
